RISCON Labs (`https://risconlabs.com`) investigates a foundational bottleneck in high-stakes human-AI interaction: **most human queries contain hidden presupposition defects, and frontier LLMs systematically evade strict verification rubrics through "Soft-Null Evasion" (copying unedited source text while reporting low confidence) or ungrounded citation drift.**

RISCON Labs (`https://risconlabs.com`) investigates a foundational bottleneck in high-stakes human-AI interaction: **most human queries contain hidden presupposition defects, and frontier LLMs systematically evade strict verification rubrics through "Soft-Null Evasion" (copying unedited source text while reporting low confidence) or ungrounded citation drift.**

Unlike conceptual proposals, RISCON Labs operates **16 live, continuously verified open-access research platforms** spanning statutory & case-law interpretation (`https://pro-se.risconlabs.com`: 610 questions, 1,461 cases, 114 monograph volumes), precision oncology survival synthesis (`https://iatheon.risconlabs.com`: 21,479 MSK-CHORD patient records, 326 research units), clinical longevity trial auditing (`https://hebe.risconlabs.com`: 320 trials, 275 papers), and AI governance/interpretability (`https://asi-2030.risconlabs.com`, `https://nadir.risconlabs.com`, `https://ordo.risconlabs.com`: 3,600+ structured audit records).

With support from **Gemini Academic Program & Google Cloud for Researchers / Startups**, we will scale our deterministic 5-stage hybrid verification pipeline across our expanding 100-sector Question-Defect Atlas, publishing reproducible benchmarks on cross-model divergence, input-truncation efficacy, and zero-hallucination citation gates.

- **Multi-Agent Orchestration Hub**: https://together.risconlabs.com (26,000+ modular audit agents organized across 10 divisions)

2. **Precision Inversion Between Frontier and Lightweight Models**: In a 100-item blind audit of `outside_fact` hallucinations, a lightweight model constrained by a 3-line negative-evidence rule achieved an **18.8% false-positive rate**, outperforming an unconstrained frontier model (**28.1% false-positive rate**) while running at **1/26th the token cost**.

By introducing a deterministic pre-LLM mechanical gate (`fix != source` + mandatory `source_quote` substring verification + length/tag invariants), we reduced Soft-Null Evasion to **0 / 420 items (0.0%)** in V10.
4. **C-Hybrid Selective Escalation (80.8% Compute Savings)**: By routing 100% of detection/drafting through lightweight batch inference and escalating only mechanical-gate rejections (8–25% of items) to high-compute reasoning models using a 5-tuple trace (`brief / draft / polished / taxonomy / patch`), we achieved **96.0% post-escalation survival** and **94.0% end-to-end assembly** at **5x relative cost vs. 26x frontier-only cost**.

## 3. 핵심 연구개발 내용 및 선행 실증 지표 (Quantitative Preliminary Results)

당사는 자체 구축한 5단계 하이브리드 검수 파이프라인(`0시드 V12 → 1탐지 → 2교정 V8/V10 → 3검수 Spark → 4재교정 → 5조립`)을 통해 다음 4가지 실측 결과를 이미 확보하였습니다 (`/Users/byungchullee/riscon/EXPERIMENT_LOG.md`, `2026-10-12` 실측):

1. **V12 입력절단(Input Truncation) 독트린**: 프롬프트 규칙 추가 대신 오염 문맥 블록(PB1)을 절단함으로써 시드 생성 성공률을 **76.0% → 88.0% (+12.0%p)**로 향상.
2. **경량 모델(Flash) 정밀도 역전 현상 실증**: 100건 블라인드 법령·판례 대조 실험에서 3줄 정밀도 억제 패치(`근거ID 없으면 지적금지` 등)를 적용한 경량 모델의 외부사실 오탐률(`outside_fact` false-positive)이 **18.8%**를 기록하여, 비제약 대형 모델(Pro, **28.1%**) 대비 오탐을 **9.3%p** 절감.
3. **회피성 무응답(Soft-Null Evasion) 전수 차단**: 엄격한 루브릭 하에서 LLM이 원문을 그대로 복사(`fix == 원문`)하고 신뢰도를 `low`로 표기해 성공률을 속이는 Soft-Null 현상(419건 중 25건 발생)을 기계 게이트로 적발하여 **V10에서 Soft-Null 0건(0.0%)** 달성.
4. **비용 80.8% 절감 하이브리드 아키텍처**: 전량 대형 모델 투입(26x 비용) 대비, 기계 게이트 탈락분(8~25%)에만 상위 모델을 투입하는 C-하이브리드 구조로 **5x 비용에서 최종 조립 완주율 94.0%, 교정 생존율 96.0%** 달성.
